Premium Stainless Steel Wire Mesh


Prime Industrial Metals manufactures high-quality Stainless Steel Wire Mesh suitable for filtration, screening, protection, construction, food processing, pharmaceutical, petrochemical and industrial applications.


FEATURES


• Corrosion resistant

• High tensile strength

• Excellent durability

• Uniform mesh opening

• Heat resistant

• Available in custom sizes


APPLICATIONS


• Industrial Filtration

• Chemical Plants

• Food Processing Industry

• Pharmaceutical Industry

• Mining

• Construction

• Automotive


SPECIFICATIONS


Material: SS304, SS304L, SS316, SS316L

Wire Diameter: 0.03 mm – 5 mm

Mesh Size: 2 Mesh – 500 Mesh

Weave Type: Plain Weave, Twill Weave, Dutch Weave

Roll Width: 0.5 m – 2 m

Standard Roll Length: 30 m


WHY CHOOSE US


• ISO quality manufacturing

• Custom sizes available

• Bulk order support

• Fast domestic and international shipping

• OEM & ODM manufacturing

• Competitive factory pricing


Custom manufacturing, OEM production and bulk export orders are accepted worldwide. Our Stainless Steel Wire Mesh is widely used in filtration systems, construction projects, pharmaceutical plants, food processing facilities, mining operations, petrochemical industries and industrial screening applications.

productDetails.productTitle: Plain Weave Stainless Steel Wire Mesh
productDetails.subProductDescription: Plain Weave Stainless Steel Wire Mesh is the most widely used woven mesh for industrial filtration, screening and protection. Manufactured in SS304, SS304L, SS316 and SS316L grades, it offers excellent corrosion resistance, uniform openings, high tensile strength and long service life. Suitable for pharmaceutical, food processing, mining, construction and chemical industries. Available in custom mesh sizes, wire diameters and roll widths.
